entry.title: Resolution 702 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County): Council: Adopts Res. 703-24 - 11/8/2024
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO THE HAWAI‘I KEIKI MUSEUM FOR EXPENSES RELATING TO THE COORDINATION AND FACILITATION OF THE K-12 EDUCATION WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT PROJECT

Transfers $3,625 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 1)

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 703-24 - 11/8/2024
